#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>

class FastScanner {
public:
    explicit FastScanner() {
        read();
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int a = 0;
        bool isNegative = false;
        char b = nextByte();
        while (b <= ' ') b = nextByte();
        if (b == '-') {
            isNegative = true;
            b = nextByte();
        }
        while (b > ' ') {
            a = a * 10 + (b - '0');
            b = nextByte();
        }
        return isNegative ? -a : a;
    }

private:
    std::vector<char> buffer;
    size_t bufferOffset = 0;
    bool isEndOfFile = false;

    void read() {
        buffer.resize(65536);
        size_t length = fread(buffer.data(), 1, buffer.size(), stdin);
        if (length > 0) {
            buffer.resize(length);
        } else {
            buffer.clear();
            isEndOfFile = true;
        }
        bufferOffset = 0;
    }

    char nextByte() {
        if (bufferOffset == buffer.size()) {
            if (!isEndOfFile) read();
            if (isEndOfFile || buffer.empty()) return 0;
        }
        return buffer[bufferOffset++];
    }
};

int n = 0, k = 0;
std::vector<int> kbeg, kend;
int numRotates = 0;
int minNumRotates = 0;

void SaveRotates(int num) {
    if (minNumRotates == 0) minNumRotates = num;
    else minNumRotates = std::min(minNumRotates, num);
}

void CalcRotates(int side, int* tmin, int* tmax, int noffset, int koffset, bool isInterval) {
    if (tmin[0] > n || tmin[1] > n) return;
    else if ((tmin[0] <= n && tmax[0] >= n) || (tmin[1] <= n && tmax[1] >= n)) {
        if ((tmax[0] < n && side == 1) || (tmax[1] < n && side == 0)) {
            SaveRotates(numRotates + 1);
        } else {
            SaveRotates(numRotates);
        }
        return;
    } else if (koffset == k) return;

    if (isInterval) {
        if (kbeg[koffset] == kend[koffset]) {
            // no rotate
            CalcRotates(side, tmin, tmax, noffset, koffset + 1, false);

            // rotate
            numRotates++;
            CalcRotates(1 - side, tmin, tmax, noffset, koffset + 1, false);
            numRotates--;

        } else {
            // no rotate
            tmin[side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
            tmax[side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
            CalcRotates(side, tmin, tmax, kend[koffset], koffset + 1, false);
            tmin[side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
            tmax[side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];

            // rotate once
            tmax[side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
            tmax[1 - side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
            numRotates++;
            CalcRotates(1 - side, tmin, tmax, kend[koffset], koffset + 1, false);
            numRotates--;
            tmax[side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
            tmax[1 - side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];

            // rotate twice
            tmax[side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
            tmin[1 - side] += 1;
            tmax[1 - side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset] - 1;
            numRotates += 2;
            CalcRotates(side, tmin, tmax, kend[koffset], koffset + 1, false);
            numRotates -= 2;
            tmax[side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
            tmin[1 - side] -= 1;
            tmax[1 - side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset] - 1;
        }
    } else {
        tmin[side] += kbeg[koffset] - noffset;
        tmax[side] += kbeg[koffset] - noffset;
        CalcRotates(side, tmin, tmax, kbeg[koffset], koffset, true);
        tmin[side] -= kbeg[koffset] - noffset;
        tmax[side] -= kbeg[koffset] - noffset;
    }
}

int main() {
    FastScanner scanner;
    n = scanner.nextInt();
    k = scanner.nextInt();

    kbeg.resize(k);
    kend.resize(k);

    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        kbeg[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        kend[i] = scanner.nextInt();
    }

    int tmin[2] = {0, 0};
    int tmax[2] = {0, 0};

    minNumRotates = 0;
    numRotates = 0;
    SaveRotates(0);
    CalcRotates(0, tmin, tmax, 0, 0, false);

    if (minNumRotates > 0) {
        std::cout << "Full\n" << minNumRotates << "\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "Hungry\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
